tableNotes: Two players (Leonardo and his girlfriend), each playing two characters; one has played D&D before and one is new, so explain rules gently and let anyone take back an action they did not understand. Play is usually by voice. Standard array, heroic tone. There are NO printed maps: never remind the players to cover or uncover maps. Phandalin is the town; Phandelver is the lost mine and the old pact. The characters have NOT identified the two dead horses on the Triboar Trail: do not say whose they are (Gundren's and Sildar's) or name their riders until the story tells the characters, through a clue or a conversation. Raechyl is pronounced Rachel.
